name: Proton
notes: All Proton services (Mail, VPN, Pass, ...) and legacy domains protonmail.ch / protonmail.com share the single Proton account login (account.proton.me). FIDO2/U2F security keys — including passkeys acting as one — are supported as a second factor only; passwordless passkey sign-in to a Proton account is not available (still an open feature request). Proton's Pass passkey docs describe the Proton Pass password manager storing passkeys for third-party sites, not Proton account login. Confirmed via community issue #15.
